unit.why: A self-contained legend about Nahmanides (the Ramban) in Barcelona, a pre-Hasidic kabbalist, using holy names to move a ship.

stories.start_quote: מעשה הרמב״ן בברצילינו שהוליך ספינה ברוח שפתיו
stories.end_quote: עשו בני העיר מגדל אחד בעד הון עתק לזכרון עד היום
stories.summary_en: In Barcelona the Ramban boasts that he can move a new ship that no one can launch. The king forces him to do it, so he adjures the ship with holy names and escapes with a sailor by contracting the road. The sailor returns home by a note bearing a holy name, but he forgets to remove it, so the ship sails onto land and halts in the middle of the city, where a tower is built as a memorial.
